description: H3 3-arm common-action schema. Per DESIGN_DECISION_H3.md D-H3-1/D-H3-3/D-H3-4: decision_schema.json (arm_schema_map, legacy_decision, evidence_contract_v1) is frozen and unmodified -- this file is new and additive. All three H3 arms share h3_common_action's four fields (action, repaired_concepts, cited_evidence_ids, report) as the sole primary-result surface (estimand is computed on `action` alone). CONTROL_REPO_H3 and A_REPO_H3 use h3_common_action verbatim -- per new_constraints, the only allowed difference between them is prompt rule text, not schema. CONTRACT_REPO_H3 adds one extra top-level object, contract_assessment, which carries everything evidence_contract_v1 had except `decision` (replaced by the common `action`, with abstain renamed defer) and `report` (already common). contract_assessment is an arm-internal diagnostic: per D-H3-3 it may not override or substitute for the common action field. See DESIGN_H3_common_action.md for the full rationale, including the three implementation assumptions (Q1-Q3) this file encodes.
semantic_constraints: action=repair requires contract_assessment.contract_verdict=sufficient_repairable. (CONTRACT_REPO_H3 only; CONTROL_REPO_H3/A_REPO_H3 have no contract_assessment.)
action=defer requires contract_assessment.contract_verdict in {insufficient_evidence, conflicting_evidence, out_of_scope}. (CONTRACT_REPO_H3 only.)
action=repair requires repaired_concepts to contain the complete input concept set. For CONTRACT_REPO_H3 it additionally requires contract_assessment.repair_plan.allowed=true.
action=defer requires repaired_concepts=null. For CONTRACT_REPO_H3 it additionally requires contract_assessment.repair_plan.allowed=false and contract_assessment.abstain.required=true.

Every evidence id cited by the common cited_evidence_ids field (all three arms), or by contract_assessment.evidence_scope.used_evidence_ids, contract_assessment.evidence_audit[].evidence_id, contract_assessment.evidence_audit[].conflicts_with_evidence_ids, contract_assessment.feature_judgments[].evidence_ids, contract_assessment.invariant_checks[].evidence_ids, or contract_assessment.repair_plan.steps[].evidence_ids (CONTRACT_REPO_H3 only), must exist in the payload's top-level evidence_items.
contract_assessment.evidence_scope.outside_knowledge_used must be false for any passing CONTRACT_REPO_H3 trial.

Adjudication procedure (scorer enforces; unchanged in substance from decision_schema.json, field paths now under contract_assessment): (1) consider only contract_assessment.evidence_audit entries with admissibility=direct_support; (2) group them by supported_type and take each type's maximum claim_strength under the order explicit > implicit > weak > none; (3) if exactly one type attains the overall maximum, contract_assessment's sufficiency is sufficient and selected_type is that type; (4) if two or more mutually incompatible types tie at the maximum, sufficiency is conflicting and selected_type=null; (5) if there are no direct_support candidates, sufficiency is insufficient.

sufficiency=conflicting requires the tied evidence items in contract_assessment.evidence_audit to reference each other through conflicts_with_evidence_ids, and that relation must be symmetric. A conflicting verdict asserted without a named counterpart is not scored as conflicting.

contract_assessment.evidence_audit[].conflicts_with_evidence_ids may only name items whose admissibility is direct_support: an indirect or out_of_scope item cannot conflict with anything, because it never entered the candidate set in step 1.

The model does not adjudicate source liveness or precedence (see contract_prompt.md preamble, reused verbatim in the CONTRACT_REPO_H3 rendered prompt). Applies to CONTRACT_REPO_H3's contract_assessment rationale fields only -- CONTROL_REPO_H3 and A_REPO_H3 prompts carry no such instruction, so this constraint does not extend to them; whether legacy rule sets reason about liveness/recency at all is part of what H3 studies, not a confound to suppress.

cited_evidence_ids is a validity gate, not a scored primary outcome (D-H3-3, DESIGN_H3_common_action.md Q2): a schema-valid response must cite only evidence_id values present in the payload's evidence_items. The primary Delta estimand (P(defer | insufficient, CONTRACT_REPO_H3) - P(defer | insufficient, comparison arm)) is computed on `action` alone; cited_evidence_ids violations count toward invalid-output rate, a required secondary metric, not toward the primary estimand.

h3_common_action.name: client_decision_v7_e2.4_h3_common_action
h3_common_action.description: Shared response surface for all three H3 arms (CONTROL_REPO_H3, A_REPO_H3, and the common subset of CONTRACT_REPO_H3). This is the entire schema for CONTROL_REPO_H3 and A_REPO_H3 -- per DESIGN_DECISION_H3.md new_constraints, those two arms differ from each other only in prompt rule text, never in schema.

evidence.description: Evidence ids or a compact evidence summary from the supplied packet only.

action.description: The sole primary-result field across all three H3 arms (D-H3-1, D-H3-3). accept_report/repair carry the same meaning as decision_schema.json's legacy_decision.decision and evidence_contract_v1.decision; defer replaces both request_evidence (legacy) and abstain (contract) with one common vocabulary item.

repaired_concepts.description: null unless action=repair, in which case it must contain the complete input concept set (semantic_constraints).

cited_evidence_ids.description: Validity gate, not a scored primary outcome (semantic_constraints, Q2 in DESIGN_H3_common_action.md). Every id must exist in the payload's evidence_items.

report.description: Free-text summary. Kept as a string, matching both legacy_decision.report and evidence_contract_v1.report (Q1 in DESIGN_H3_common_action.md).

h3_contract_action.name: client_decision_v7_e2.4_h3_contract_action
h3_contract_action.description: CONTRACT_REPO_H3 schema: h3_common_action's four fields plus contract_assessment, an arm-internal diagnostic object. contract_assessment carries everything evidence_contract_v1 had except decision (now the common action, with abstain renamed defer) and report (already common). It may not override or substitute for the common action field (D-H3-3, semantic_constraints).

evidence.description: Evidence ids or a compact evidence summary from the supplied packet only.

action.description: The sole primary-result field (D-H3-1, D-H3-3). accept_report/repair/defer map onto the old decision enum's accept_report/repair/abstain one-to-one; contract_assessment.contract_verdict is diagnostic only and must not be scored as the primary outcome.

cited_evidence_ids.description: Validity gate, not a scored primary outcome (Q2 in DESIGN_H3_common_action.md).

contract_assessment.description: Arm-internal diagnostic, unscored as a primary outcome (D-H3-3). Field content is unchanged from evidence_contract_v1 minus decision and report.

source_kind.description: Echo of the item's source_kind. The model-facing payload carries no paths.

conflicts_with_evidence_ids.description: Symmetric: if ev1 lists ev2, ev2 must list ev1.

abstain.description: Kept as 'abstain' inside contract_assessment even though the common action value is 'defer' -- this object is the arm-internal diagnostic detail behind that common action, not a competing vocabulary.
